title: 2026 F1 DUTCH GP Race analysis by Peter Windsor
description: Although Max Verstappen crashed out of the Dutch GP on lap one, the race itself was far from flat; the Pirelli hard tyre saw to that. Its surprisingly high degradation rate shocked those who had predicted a straightforward medium-hard one-stop strategy and led to some intense racing for most of the distance.
